content.title: Pyxis Tankers price target lowered to $9 from $10 at Alliance Global Partners
content.summary: Alliance Global Partners lowered the firm’s price target on Pyxis Tankers (PXS) to $9 from $10 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. The firm notes the company reported adjusted Q1 EBITDA of $3.5M, which was lower than its estimate of $4.4M mainly due to softer tanker and dry bulk TCE revenue and TCE rates.
